atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(100, "Coil Lookback", 20, 200, 1)
volVoLookback = input(20, "Vol-of-Vol Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Mult", 1.0, 3.0, 0.1)
predictLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

prevClose = close[1]
tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - prevClose)
tr3 = abs(low - prevClose)
tr = max(tr1, max(tr2, tr3))
rng = high - low

a = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)

hiA = highest(a, coilLookback)
loA = lowest(a, coilLookback)
atrRange = max(hiA - loA, 0.000000001)
coilLoad = 1 - (a - loA) / atrRange

rangeHi = highest(rng, coilLookback)
rangeLo = lowest(rng, coilLookback)
rangeSpan = max(rangeHi - rangeLo, 0.000000001)
rangePos = (rng - rangeLo) / rangeSpan
rangeCoiled = rangePos < 0.2
rangeAtLow = rng < rangeLo + rangeSpan * 0.1
atrCoiled = coilLoad > 0.8

atrChg = (a - a[1]) / max(a[1], 0.000000001)
absChg = abs(atrChg)
meanAbs = sma(absChg, volVoLookback)
sdChg = stdev(atrChg, volVoLookback)
vov = sdChg / max(meanAbs, 0.000000001)
vovRising = vov > vov[1] and vov[1] > vov[2] and vov[2] > vov[3]

cumTr = cum(tr)
cumTrPast = cumTr[predictLen]
sumTR = cumTr - cumTrPast
disp = abs(close - close[predictLen])
predict = disp / max(sumTR, 0.000000001)

releaseImp = rng / max(a, 0.000000001)
expansion = rng > releaseMult * a
expansionPrev = rng[1] > releaseMult * a[1]
expansionEdge = expansion and not expansionPrev

hhPrev = highest(high, predictLen)[1]
llPrev = lowest(low, predictLen)[1]

warm = bar_index > coilLookback

var lastFire = -100
barsSinceFire = bar_index - lastFire
canFire = barsSinceFire > 5

armed = warm and coilLoad > 0.8 and atrCoiled and rangeCoiled and rangeAtLow and vovRising
buySig = armed and expansionEdge and close > hhPrev and canFire
sellSig = armed and expansionEdge and close < llPrev and canFire

if buySig {
  lastFire := bar_index
}
if sellSig {
  lastFire := bar_index
}

if buySig { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if buySig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 1, "separate") }
if sellSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "separate") }

plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predict, "Predictability", "#ffd43b", 1, "separate")

coilFlat = coilLoad * (1 - predict)
coilPeak = coilLoad * predict * releaseImp
plot3d(coilFlat, "Loaded Unpredictable", "surface", "#b48cff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(coilPeak, "Loaded Predictable", "bars3d", "#22cc88", "separate", 1)

if expansion { bgcolor("#ff447722") }

// Multi-Timeframe Siege Breakout
// Session extremes + confirmed 1h structure + confidence + hard stop

sessLen = input(20, "SessionLengthBars", 10, 100, 1)
structLB = input(3, "StructureLookback1h", 1, 20, 1)
minDispPct = input(0.1, "MinDisplacementPct", 0.0, 5.0, 0.05)
confThresh = input(60, "ConfidenceThreshold", 0, 100, 1)
stopTicks = input(10, "HardStopOffsetTicks", 1, 100, 1)
tickSize = input(0.1, "Tick Size", 0.01, 10.0, 0.01)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
sessHighPrev = sessHigh[1]
sessLowPrev = sessLow[1]
midRange = (sessHigh + sessLow) / 2
midPrev = midRange[1]

hClose = security("1h", close)
hOpen = security("1h", open)
hHigh = security("1h", high)
hLow = security("1h", low)

priorHigh = highest(hHigh, structLB)[1]
priorLow = lowest(hLow, structLB)[1]
prevHHigh = hHigh[1]
prevHLow = hLow[1]

hRange = hHigh - hLow
dispRaw = hRange > 0 ? abs(hClose - hOpen) / hRange : 0
dispCapped = min(max(dispRaw, 0), 1)
minDisp = minDispPct / 100

bullBreak = hClose - priorHigh
bearBreak = priorLow - hClose
bullNormRaw = hRange > 0 ? bullBreak / hRange : 0
bearNormRaw = hRange > 0 ? bearBreak / hRange : 0
bullNorm = min(max(bullNormRaw, 0), 1)
bearNorm = min(max(bearNormRaw, 0), 1)

confBullRaw = 50 + 25 * dispCapped + 25 * bullNorm
confBearRaw = 50 + 25 * dispCapped + 25 * bearNorm
confBull = min(max(confBullRaw, 0), 100)
confBear = min(max(confBearRaw, 0), 100)

bullHL = hLow > prevHLow
bearLH = hHigh < prevHHigh
bullStructure = hClose > priorHigh and bullHL
bearStructure = hClose < priorLow and bearLH
bullEdge = bullStructure and not bullStructure[1]
bearEdge = bearStructure and not bearStructure[1]

confidence = bullStructure ? confBull : bearStructure ? confBear : 50
confScore = confidence / 100

longStop = sessLow - stopTicks * tickSize
shortStop = sessHigh + stopTicks * tickSize

var inPos = 0
activeStop = inPos == 1 ? longStop : inPos == -1 ? shortStop : close

longRiskPct = close > 0 ? (close - longStop) / close * 100 : 1
shortRiskPct = close > 0 ? (shortStop - close) / close * 100 : 1
longRisk = min(max(longRiskPct, 0.01), 100)
shortRisk = min(max(shortRiskPct, 0.01), 100)

buySig = crossover(close, sessHighPrev) and bullStructure and confidence >= confThresh and dispCapped >= minDisp
sellSig = crossunder(close, sessLowPrev) and bearStructure and confidence >= confThresh and dispCapped >= minDisp
exitLongSig = crossunder(close, midPrev) or bearEdge
exitShortSig = crossover(close, midPrev) or bullEdge
exitLongGated = exitLongSig and inPos == 1
exitShortGated = exitShortSig and inPos == -1

if buySig {
    model.confidence(confScore)
    model.stopLoss(longRisk)
    model.longEntry("siege-long")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    inPos := 1
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(confScore)
    model.stopLoss(shortRisk)
    model.shortEntry("siege-short")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    inPos := -1
}
if exitLongGated {
    model.longExit("siege-long")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exit Long", "xcross", "#ffcc33")
    inPos := 0
}
if exitShortGated {
    model.shortExit("siege-short")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit Short", "xcross", "#33ccff")
    inPos := 0
}

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(activeStop, "Hard Stop", "#ffcc33", 1, "stepline")

fastLen = input(10, "Fast Volatility Length", 5, 20, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Medium Volatility Length", 20, 50, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Volatility Length", 40, 100, 1)
skewLen = input(60, "Skew Range Length", 40, 100, 1)
compThresh = input(0.70, "Compression Ratio Threshold", 0.3, 0.95, 0.05)
bullLvl = input(0.15, "Skew Bullish Flip Level", 0.05, 0.4, 0.01)
bearLvl = input(-0.15, "Skew Bearish Flip Level", -0.4, -0.05, 0.01)
annFactor = input(252, "Annualization Factor", 1, 365, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

ratio = close / max(close[1], 0.000001)
r = log(ratio)
ann = sqrt(annFactor)
fastRV = stdev(r, fastLen) * ann
medRV = stdev(r, medLen) * ann
slowRV = stdev(r, slowLen) * ann
hh = highest(high, skewLen)
ll = lowest(low, skewLen)
rng = hh - ll
denom = max(rng, 0.000001)
pos = (close - ll) / denom
skew = pos - 0.5
spread = fastRV - slowRV
slopeMid = medRV - slowRV
compression = fastRV < medRV * compThresh and fastRV < slowRV * compThresh
compRecent = compression or compression[1] or compression[2] or compression[3] or compression[4] or compression[5]
expansionUp = fastRV > medRV * compThresh and fastRV[1] <= medRV[1] * compThresh and compRecent
skewCrossUp = skew > bullLvl and skew[1] <= bullLvl
skewCrossDn = skew < bearLvl and skew[1] >= bearLvl
skewWasNeg = skew[1] < 0 and skew[2] < 0 and skew[3] < 0
skewWasPos = skew[1] > 0 and skew[2] > 0 and skew[3] > 0

var lastBuy = -1000
var lastSell = -1000

rawBuy = expansionUp and skewCrossUp and skewWasNeg
rawSell = expansionUp and skewCrossDn and skewWasPos
buySig = rawBuy and bar_index - lastBuy[1] >= 15
sellSig = rawSell and bar_index - lastSell[1] >= 15

if buySig {

  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")

}

}
